$comment: Source of truth for the agentic monitoring loop. Edited by humans, read by detect.ts and the fix workflow. Keep flat and obvious — no logic, just policy.

fix:alt.description: Missing or non-semantic image alt text

auto-fix.description: Cleared for unattended fix. Auto-runs only when MONITOR_AUTOFIX=true.

diff_filter.$comment: Permissive: file scope is the primary gate. Adversarial verify catches anything outside the metadata surface. Tighten with AST if regressions appear.
Strict: only alt= attribute literal changes. Anything else is rejected.

$max_new_issues_comment: Per-run cap on issue creation. Prevents flood on first runs / large regressions. Detector still emits all findings (visible in run logs); only the first N create issues. Bump after soak.

canary.$comment: Synthetic finding that the SEO detector must always emit. If absent on any run, the workflow fails loudly and Slack-alerts. Catches silent API contract drift.
canary.expected_message: Synthetic canary: robots.txt fetched and contains a User-agent directive. If you see this in an issue, the canary should have been suppressed — investigate detect.ts.

detection_thresholds.$comment: Conservative day-one defaults. Tune after week 1 review.

meta_length.$comment: Page-fetch detection of malformed title/description tags. Single-run + 7d cooldown handles flap; no consecutive-runs requirement at v1.

prompt_versions.$comment: Bumped manually when a prompt is materially changed. Logged in every issue body for audit.
